help.title: Help
help.start_1: On the left "Nodes" tab, drag a node onto the canvas or click it — it drops into the center.
help.start_3: Type the task in the field at the bottom — it enters the "User Input" node and flows onward.
help.conn_1: Hover a node — port dots appear on its edges. Drag a line from one node to another.
help.conn_2: You can drag from any side. The parent is the node you dragged FROM; the line animates away from it.
help.conn_3: To break a link — hover the line and click the red circle. The nodes stay.
help.conn_4: If a connection isn’t allowed, a tooltip explains why while you drag.
help.link_1: Data flow: "User Input → agent → output". The task and result travel along it. Loops are not allowed.
help.link_2: Capability attach: "tool ↔ agent". This gives the agent a skill (web search, files, etc.). No data flows along it.
help.grp_agents: Agents — do the actual work (think, write, analyze). Each takes an instruction.
help.grp_tools: Tools — agent capabilities. Attach to an agent. Web Search really works today.
help.grp_logic: Logic — Condition (Yes/No branch), Condition Agent (decides itself) and Loop (bounded repeat).
help.grp_flow: Flow — User Input (start), Markdown (on-screen result), Telegram (delivery to a chat).
help.logic_1: Condition = one question, two outputs: green "Yes", red "No". Operator: contains / not contains / equals.
help.logic_2: Three outcomes = two Conditions chained (the "No" branch leads into the second).
help.logic_3: Loop repeats the chain: pick "return to" and the number of passes (up to 8). Each pass gets the previous result.
help.run_1: "Demo" — free simulation, no Claude call. "Real" — a true run that spends tokens on your key.
help.run_2: Before a real run the workflow is checked: it warns about unconnected nodes and a missing agent.
help.run_3: A filled node is tinted with its own color — you instantly see what’s ready and what isn’t.
help.mis_1: A tool placed "between" agents in the flow. No — a tool attaches to the side of an agent.
help.mis_2: A node left without links — the flow won’t reach it. Connect it to the chain.
help.mis_3: Telegram: for a private chat use the numeric chat ID only; @name works only for channels where the bot is admin.
